children: Total construction activity in Saudi Arabia rose for the fourth month in a row, led by residential developments amid resilient demand conditions, Alrajhi Capital said in its latest survey.
The headline seasonally adjusted Saudi Construction Index reached 55.4 in August, slightly up from 55.2 in July, the second-highest since the survey began in January.
Residential building was the fastest-growing area of construction activity for the third time in the past four months.

Infrastructure activity rose at a solid rate last month, but the speed of expansion moderated since July. However, infrastructure remained the best-performing category for new work, with the fastest expansion rate since February.
Many firms reported stronger growth momentum due to improving market conditions, new project starts and work on major urban development schemes.
Survey respondents remained highly upbeat on the 2026 outlook, with 42 percent expecting an upturn in overall business activity, while only 7 percent predicting a decline, the survey found.

“Although input cost inflation accelerated during August, firms remained optimistic about the outlook, supported by healthy project pipelines and expectations of continued activity growth,” said Sultan Altowaim, Head of Research at Alrajhi Capital.

title: Residential buildings lead Saudi Arabia’s construction sector activity in August: Survey
